name: Random Number Generator
description: Generate a truly random integer within any custom range. Perfect for giveaways, raffles, statistical sampling, or picking a winner from a numbered list — powered by cryptographic randomness.
shortDescription: Generate a random integer within any range.

name: Alphabet Randomizer
description: Pick a random letter from A to Z with optional exclusions. Perfect for classroom vocabulary games, Scattergories, or any word-based random selection.
shortDescription: Pick a random letter from A to Z with exclusions.

name: Date Randomizer
description: Pick a completely random date and optional time within any range. Perfect for writers creating historical settings, developers generating dummy data, or planning a surprise trip.
shortDescription: Pick a random date within any range.

name: Dice Roller
description: Roll virtual dice with realistic 3D animation. Choose from d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, or d20 dice and roll up to 6 at once. Perfect for tabletop RPGs, board games, or any situation needing dice simulation — powered by cryptographic randomness.
shortDescription: Roll virtual dice with realistic 3D animation.

name: JSON Prettifier
description: Prettify and format raw or compressed JSON with custom indentation. Choose between 2 spaces, 4 spaces, or tabs, and optionally sort keys alphabetically for cleaner, more readable output.
shortDescription: Format and prettify raw JSON with custom indentation.

name: JSON Path Query Evaluator
description: Evaluate JSONPath and JMESPath queries against JSON data in real time. Paste a JSON payload, write a query expression, and see the filtered result update live with syntax highlighting.
shortDescription: Run JSONPath and JMESPath queries on JSON data live.

name: JSON Diff & Patch Comparer
description: Compare two JSON documents side by side with a visual line-by-line diff. Additions appear in green, deletions in red, and modifications in yellow. Generate an RFC 6902 JSON Patch payload for the detected changes.
shortDescription: Visual diff two JSON documents and generate RFC 6902 patches.

name: JSON to YAML / TOML Converter
description: Convert JSON to YAML or TOML and back in real time. Type in either panel and see the other update instantly. Handles nested objects, arrays, null values, and preserves data types correctly.
shortDescription: Bidirectional converter between JSON, YAML, and TOML.

name: JSON Minifier
description: Minify and compact formatted JSON by stripping all non-essential whitespace, line breaks, and indentation. Shows the exact percentage of file size reduction achieved for payload optimisation.
shortDescription: Minify JSON and see the exact size reduction percentage.

name: JSON Fixer
description: Automatically repair malformed, corrupted, or non-strict JSON. Fixes trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, missing brackets, and other common syntax issues. Displays a detailed log of every fix applied.
shortDescription: Auto-repair broken JSON and log every fix applied.

name: JSON to HTML Table
description: Transform a JSON array of objects into an interactive HTML data table with column sorting, text filtering, and dot-notation flattening for nested keys. Export the result to a real Excel spreadsheet.
shortDescription: Convert JSON arrays to sortable HTML tables with Excel export.

name: JSON String Escaper
description: Escape or unescape JSON strings for use in source code. Escape mode converts JSON into a single-line string literal with proper backslash encoding. Unescape mode reverses the process back to readable JSON.
shortDescription: Escape and unescape JSON strings for source code integration.

name: BSON / MessagePack Decoder
description: Decode BSON (MongoDB) and MessagePack binary payloads into readable JSON. Upload a file or paste a hex string and get a fully highlighted, formatted JSON output ready for inspection or download.
shortDescription: Decode BSON and MessagePack binary data into formatted JSON.

name: JSON Tree Visualizer
description: Visualise deeply nested JSON as an interactive expandable tree diagram. Click nodes to collapse or expand branches, and hover to reveal data types and raw values for each key.
shortDescription: Visualise JSON as an interactive expandable tree diagram.

name: Mock JSON Generator
description: Generate realistic mock JSON data from a JSON Schema definition. Specify properties, types, constraints, and formats — the engine produces sample records that satisfy the schema rules, perfect for API testing and prototyping.
shortDescription: Generate realistic mock JSON data from a JSON Schema definition.
